_readme: AGENT-ADDABLE level theme. Levels cycle through theme files in data/levels/ (sorted by filename); generation params scale with level number in code. To add a theme: drop a new theme_*.json here — no code changes. algorithm is one of: scatter | aisles | rings | clusters | rooms (new algorithms require code — flagged exception). Colors are hex. min_clearance is the guaranteed dodge corridor width in meters — do not set below 2.5. 'order' sets the level rotation position (level 1 = lowest order — keep it the easiest, it's the tutorial hook).
name: The Shop — Classic Floor
